Villainized

  • Whenever a villainized creature takes damage, it suffers 1d6 additional psychic damage. It cannot take this damage again until it performs a hostile action.
  • Villainized creatures have disadvantage on Presence (Persuasion) checks.
  • Villainized does not stack. If a creature gains the villainized condition while already villainized, only the effect with the longer remaining duration remains.
